Class TaskCommandManagerImpl

java.lang.Object
com.owltask.task.manager.TaskCommandManagerImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
TaskCommandManager
public class TaskCommandManagerImpl extends Object implements TaskCommandManager
Translates the public TaskCommandManager API into calls on two internal service classes: TaskWriteService and TaskAssignmentService. This is the "manager spans more than one internal class" case the professor called out.

createTask() is the concrete example: it creates the task via TaskWriteService, then (UC-11 basic assignment) assigns each requested username via TaskAssignmentService - two internal classes, one public call.
